display_name: CanBank IBAC demo (Auth0 people, Token Service)
description: Config-as-data for a2a/ibac-demo: the CanBank graph (departments, documents, accounts, invoices, agent workflows) with the music demo's people as the only identities. Every Person external_id is an Auth0 subject (auth0|<id>): the twelve real users of the music tenant plus their relatives with synthetic subs of the same shape. Logins are Persons; staff WORKS_IN a Department, customers IS_CUSTOMER a Customer record of the core banking system, parents are PARENT_OF their children and minors are IS_AGE_GROUP minor. Agents are Auth0 machine-to-machine subjects supplied by instant-stack .env as AUTH0_SUB_<AGENT>; the Auth0 issuer comes from AUTH0_ISSUER and the Token Service public key from TOKEN_SERVICE_PUBLIC_JWK. KBAC policies cover the Agent Gateway admission (CAN_TRIGGER on the Agent the delegation chain ends at, compared with $ik_token.act_chain), its capability checks (CAN_USE on the Tool, McpResource, Prompt and Skill nodes an Agent HAS per workflow), its capability checks (CAN_USE on the Tool, McpResource, Prompt and Skill nodes an Agent HAS per workflow), its capability checks (CAN_USE on the Tool, McpResource, Prompt and Skill nodes an Agent HAS per workflow), the console's workflow grants (CAN_TRIGGER on Workflow), the ERP (CAN_VIEW Invoice), the chain guard, and the Intent Agent vocabulary for staff, customers and guardians.

ciq_queries.name: get-self
ciq_queries.description: Retrieve the authenticated person's profile: department and manager for staff, customer record for customers. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-self", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-stock-quote
ciq_queries.description: Get Stock Quote retrieves the person, their department and a stock quote for the requested ticker symbol.The only information required is the currently authenticated person's bearer token and a ticker symbol for the stock. Use this function when the person asks questions about stock quotes, such as: 'What is the current price of <ticker>?' Returns: An object containing the person's details, including full_name, department, and the stock price. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with the person's bearer token as the authorization header. Use the following arguments: "id": "get-stock-quote" and "ticker". Example: { "id": "get-stock-quote", "input_params": { "ticker": "NVDA"} }."

ciq_queries.name: get-stock-trade-threshold
ciq_queries.description: Retrieve a customer's stock account tier and threshold. Caller must be in the trading department. Example: { "id": "get-stock-trade-threshold", "input_params": { "customer_external_id": "cust-cashmere" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-internal-documents
ciq_queries.description: Retrieve internal documents visible to the caller filtered by taxonomy. Example: { "id": "get-internal-documents", "input_params": { "taxonomy_external_id": "policy" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-customer-facing-documents
ciq_queries.description: Retrieve customer facing documents with their regulatory agreements and investment categories. Example: { "id": "get-customer-facing-documents", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-regulatory-agreements
ciq_queries.description: Retrieve the full list of regulatory agreements. Example: { "id": "get-regulatory-agreements", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-decisions
ciq_queries.description: get-decisions retrieves past decisions that have been made based on a document, probably a policy of some kind. The results include: the actor, the decision, the document applied in the decision, a relationship document_applied.type that describes the relationship between the decision and the document, the support ticket, and account. The only information required is the currently authenticated person's bearer token. Use this function when we need to find past decisions such as: "What decisions incorporated the refund policy document?" Returns: An object containing the decision, the document, a relationship that explains how the document was applied, the actor, the support ticket and the affected account. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with the person's bearer token as the authorization header. Use the following arguments: "id": "get-decisions". Example: { "id": "get-decisions", "input_params": { "document_external_id": "refund_policy" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-hq-weather
ciq_queries.description: Get HQ Weather returns the current weather reading for CanBank's London headquarters: temperature, apparent temperature, wind speed and weather code, together with the unit labels. The hq_weather Weather node carries `latitude` and `longitude` properties that are substituted into the `weather` external data resolver URL. The `current` and `units` properties are populated live from open-meteo at query time. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-hq-weather", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_queries.name: store-decision
ciq_queries.description: Store Decision records a new decision in the knowledge graph: it creates a Decision node and links it to the policy document it applies (APPLIES), the support ticket it closes (CLOSED_BY) and the authenticated user who made it (MADE), all in one atomic operation. Use this function when a decision has been reached and must be persisted, such as: 'Record that I approved this refund as an exception to the refund policy.' Requires the person's bearer token. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with the following arguments: "id": "store-decision" and input_params decision_external_id, decision_description, document_external_id, ticket_external_id. Example: { "id": "store-decision", "input_params": { "decision_external_id": "decision_002", "decision_description": "Refund approved as an exception", "document_external_id": "refund_policy", "ticket_external_id": "ticket_001" } }.

ciq_queries.name: explain-staff-workflow-access
ciq_queries.description: Authorization-path explainer for the console's why? cards: returns the staff path Person -WORKS_IN-> Department -CAN_TRIGGER-> Workflow when it exists in the graph (empty data = no such path). Example: { "id": "explain-staff-workflow-access", "input_params": { "subject_id": "auth0|69c410bfb501d3a02bd01ea2", "workflow_id": "wf1" } }.

ciq_queries.name: explain-direct-workflow-access
ciq_queries.description: Authorization-path explainer for the console's why? cards: returns the direct Person -CAN_TRIGGER-> Workflow edge when it exists in the graph (empty data = no such path). Example: { "id": "explain-direct-workflow-access", "input_params": { "subject_id": "auth0|69c4129b0ba356c7db9f91ab", "workflow_id": "wf1" } }.

ciq_queries.name: get-internal-documents-chained
ciq_queries.description: Retrieve internal documents by taxonomy over the fully delegated agent chain. Call tool 'ciq_execute' with input_params. Example: { "id": "get-internal-documents-chained", "input_params": { "taxonomy_external_id": "policy" } }. Refused unless the request traveled console->orchestrator->retriever->mcp with the ITS delegation intact.

ciq_queries.name: get-my-family
ciq_queries.description: Retrieve the authenticated person's household: spouse or partner, children with their age group, and the accounts of children who are minors (adult children's accounts are not returned). Call tool 'ciq_execute' with no input_params. Example: { "id": "get-my-family", "input_params": { } }.

ciq_policies.name: get-self
ciq_policies.description: Return the authenticated person, their department and manager (staff) and their customer record (customers).

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person {external_id: $token.sub}) WITH subject OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[:WORKS_IN]->(department:Department) WITH subject, department OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[:REPORTS_TO]->(manager:Person) WITH subject, department, manager OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[:IS_CUSTOMER]->(customer:Customer) WITH subject, department, manager, customer, $token.act.sub AS agent

ciq_policies.name: get-stock-quote
ciq_policies.description: Return a stock quote when the caller's department is allowed to retrieve it.

ciq_policies.name: get-stock-trade-threshold
ciq_policies.description: Return a customer's stock account tier when accessed by a trading user.

ciq_policies.name: get-internal-documents
ciq_policies.description: Return internal documents reachable from the caller filtered by taxonomy.

ciq_policies.name: get-customer-facing-documents
ciq_policies.description: List customer facing documents together with their regulatory agreements and investment categories.

ciq_policies.name: get-regulatory-agreements
ciq_policies.description: List all regulatory agreements known to the graph.

ciq_policies.name: get-decisions
ciq_policies.description: Given a document, return the decisions that referenced it along with the ticket, the customer and the affected account.

ciq_policies.name: get-hq-weather
ciq_policies.description: Return the current weather reading for CanBank's London headquarters. The hq_weather Weather node's temperature property is populated at query time by the `weather` external data resolver, which calls open-meteo.

ciq_policies.name: store-decision
ciq_policies.description: Create a new Decision node and wire it to the document it applies (APPLIES), the ticket it closes (CLOSED_BY) and the authenticated user who made it (MADE) in one atomic CIQ upsert. Allowed only to staff who reach the document through their department and whose department the ticket is assigned to (ASSIGNED_TO).

ciq_policies.name: explain-staff-workflow-access
ciq_policies.description: Read the User-Department-Workflow authorization path for the console explainer (CanBank).

ciq_policies.name: explain-direct-workflow-access
ciq_policies.description: Read the direct User-Workflow CAN_TRIGGER edge for the console explainer (CanBank).

ciq_policies.name: get-internal-documents-chained
ciq_policies.description: Return internal documents filtered by taxonomy, but only when the request carries the full ITS delegation chain of the console->orchestrator->retriever->mcp route.

advice.error_description: Expected the console->orchestrator->retriever->mcp delegation chain: a depth-3 chain whose oldest actor is the orchestrator; the cypher then requires $ik_token.act_chain to list orchestrator, retriever and mcp in that order

ciq_policies.name: get-my-family
ciq_policies.description: The logged-in person's household: spouse or partner, children with their age group, and the accounts of children who are minors.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person {external_id: $token.sub}) OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r_spouse:MARRIED_TO|PARTNERS|CO_PARENTS]-(spouse:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (subject)-[r_parent:PARENT_OF]->(child:Person)-[:IS_AGE_GROUP]->(ageGroup:AgeGroup) OPTIONAL MATCH (child)-[:IS_CUSTOMER]->(:Customer)-[r_owns:OWNS]->(account:Account) WHERE ageGroup.external_id = 'minor'

resolvers.name: weather
resolvers.description: Fetches the current weather block (temperature, apparent temperature, wind speed and weather code) for the latitude/longitude passed via input_params. Defaults to CanBank's London HQ (51.5072, -0.1276) when input_params are absent. Use this as the `external_value` on a Weather node property. Pair with the `weather-units` resolver to also retrieve the unit labels.

resolvers.name: weather-units
resolvers.description: Fetches the unit labels (e.g. °C, km/h) for the current weather block at the latitude/longitude passed via input_params (defaults to London HQ).

resolvers.name: stock-quote
resolvers.description: Returns the current market price for the ticker symbol passed via the knowledge query's `ticker` input parameter. Bound to the price property of the stock_quote Quote node and consumed by the iag-demo retriever_agent's max-purchase-amount tool. Backed by Yahoo Finance's public chart endpoint; no API key required.

app_agent.name: ibac-agent
app_agent.description: App agent for the IBAC demo: gateways (whoami, AuthZEN admission), console (explain queries), ERP (search/resource) and the Intent Agent (data schema + policy listing)

audit_signing.name: audit-signing-default
audit_signing.description: Platform-managed key signs the project's tamper-proof audit chain

event_sink.name: audit-events-pubsub
event_sink.description: Delivers the project's audit events to Google Cloud Pub/Sub; delivered events are chained

mcp_server.name: ibac-mcp-server
mcp_server.description: MCP Server configuration for the IBAC demo - binds the App Agent and the Auth0 Person Token Introspect used to authenticate inbound MCP traffic.

token_introspect.name: auth0-person-introspect
token_introspect.description: Auth0 access tokens of the console login (audience ibac-console), validated offline against the tenant JWKS; the token sub is the Person external_id. The issuer comes from .env (AUTH0_ISSUER, e.g. https://<tenant>.auth0.com/).

token_introspect.name: token-service-https-ibac-console
token_introspect.description: Token-service-minted delegation JWTs arriving in X-IK-Token; audience inherited from the user subject token. The public JWK comes from .env (TOKEN_SERVICE_PUBLIC_JWK) - fetch it from the running service's /.well-known/jwks.json and strip it to kty/n/e/alg/kid/use.

kbac.name: person-can-reach-agent
kbac.description: The Agent Gateway's admission check: the subject may reach the protected agent (the newest hop of the delegation chain, resource type Agent) when a workflow they can trigger - directly or through their department - has exactly the delegation chain as its path of agents ($ik_token.act_chain, sent by the gateway in X-IK-Token). One policy serves every gateway; a chain from another workflow, or one that does not end at this agent, is refused.

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person)-[:WORKS_IN|CAN_TRIGGER*..3]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(resource:Agent) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain

kbac.name: person-can-view-profile
kbac.display_name: Person can view their own profile
kbac.description: A person may view their own profile: the resource is the person's own node. Gives prompts such as 'who am I' a vocabulary the Intent Agent can map (action CAN_VIEW_PROFILE on Person); the data itself comes from the get-self knowledge query.

kbac.name: person-can-read-weather
kbac.description: Any person may read a Weather node (the HQ weather the external data resolvers populate). Gives the weather prompts a vocabulary the Intent Agent can map (action CAN_READ on Weather); the data itself comes from the get-hq-weather knowledge query.

kbac.name: person-can-use-tool
kbac.description: The Agent Gateway's capability check for tools: the tools of an MCP server (tools/list is filtered to them, a tools/call outside them is refused with -31403). The gateway reads the permitted set with one AuthZEN search/resource (action CAN_USE, resource type Tool) per request that lists or names a capability, with the delegation in X-IK-Token. A capability is permitted when a workflow the person can trigger - directly or through their department - has exactly the delegation chain as its path of agents and the agent at the end of the chain HAS the capability for that workflow (HAS.workflow_name).

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person)-[:WORKS_IN|CAN_TRIGGER*..3]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(agent:Agent)-[h:HAS]->(resource:Tool) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain AND h.workflow_name = wf.external_id

kbac.name: person-can-use-mcp-resource
kbac.display_name: Person can use mcp resource (gateway capability)
kbac.description: The Agent Gateway's capability check for MCP resources: the resources of an MCP server (resources/list, resources/read, subscriptions). The gateway reads the permitted set with one AuthZEN search/resource (action CAN_USE, resource type McpResource) per request that lists or names a capability, with the delegation in X-IK-Token. A capability is permitted when a workflow the person can trigger - directly or through their department - has exactly the delegation chain as its path of agents and the agent at the end of the chain HAS the capability for that workflow (HAS.workflow_name).

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person)-[:WORKS_IN|CAN_TRIGGER*..3]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(agent:Agent)-[h:HAS]->(resource:McpResource) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain AND h.workflow_name = wf.external_id

kbac.name: person-can-use-prompt
kbac.description: The Agent Gateway's capability check for prompts: the prompts of an MCP server (prompts/list, prompts/get); none is modelled in this dataset, so the lists are empty. The gateway reads the permitted set with one AuthZEN search/resource (action CAN_USE, resource type Prompt) per request that lists or names a capability, with the delegation in X-IK-Token. A capability is permitted when a workflow the person can trigger - directly or through their department - has exactly the delegation chain as its path of agents and the agent at the end of the chain HAS the capability for that workflow (HAS.workflow_name).

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person)-[:WORKS_IN|CAN_TRIGGER*..3]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(agent:Agent)-[h:HAS]->(resource:Prompt) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain AND h.workflow_name = wf.external_id

kbac.name: person-can-use-skill
kbac.description: The Agent Gateway's capability check for skills: the skills of an A2A agent (the extended agent card the gateway serves lists only these; an A2A message names no skill, so this is discovery only). The gateway reads the permitted set with one AuthZEN search/resource (action CAN_USE, resource type Skill) per request that lists or names a capability, with the delegation in X-IK-Token. A capability is permitted when a workflow the person can trigger - directly or through their department - has exactly the delegation chain as its path of agents and the agent at the end of the chain HAS the capability for that workflow (HAS.workflow_name).

condition.cypher: MATCH (subject:Person)-[:WORKS_IN|CAN_TRIGGER*..3]->(wf:Workflow) MATCH (wf)-[rels:INVOKES*]->(agent:Agent)-[h:HAS]->(resource:Skill) WHERE ALL(r IN rels WHERE r.workflow_name = wf.external_id AND endNode(r):Agent) AND [r IN rels | endNode(r).external_id] = $ik_token.act_chain AND h.workflow_name = wf.external_id
